svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The same launch, before and after the method
svg.desc: Two timelines in months from launch. As written: high-memory machines commit at −6, the memory need surfaces at −3, and machines arrive at +3, a quarter late, so a bridge runs. With the method: power commits at −20, stored data is asked at −12, high-memory commits at −11, machines are on the dock by −2, ready for service at −1; no bridge at the base. The cost is about 1.0 NMU of spare, about $26,280 a year more idle at the 40,000 landing. Illustrative.

text.tspan: bridge, 0 to +3: four standard machines run
for memory, or old machines past decommission
At the 40k landing: 90 idle installed cores
